user_questions.question: Q1: Which storefronts should the rule suspend? (a) only Active [recommended], (b) Active and Pending Activation, (c) any status except Closed. Q2: Who should be told when a storefront is auto-suspended? (a) storefront record owner, (b) owner of the related Account by email [recommended], (c) no notification.
user_questions.simulated_answer: Only Active storefronts get suspended. Notify the account owner by email. Evaluate whenever a review is saved.

skill_friction: AskCoworker's I call put the flow on Review__c claiming roll-ups recalculate before child after-save flows and that roll-up updates do not fire parent flows, contradicting its own D1 and documented order of execution. The skill's table says to fix wrong details and 'send the corrected inventory to R and T', but gives no guidance on roll-up-driven automation placement; a design-rules note (automation driven by a roll-up belongs on the parent) would prevent this recurring error.

Design rule 'include a notification to the record owner' when records need follow-up overlaps with the step-5 'which persona' question; unclear whether asking who to notify is allowed or whether the rule already decides it (record owner). I asked because the Account owner was a plausible, different recipient.

Rule 3 'after two wrong AskCoworker claims, verify every AskCoworker fact you keep' - the third and fourth wrong claims arrived in R, after the spec's facts were already org-verified; it is unclear whether this should also trigger re-running earlier queries or only re-checking kept facts.

Send Email deliverability access level cannot be read with the allowed commands, and org-verification.md does not say whether that makes the email responsibility blocking for delivery; I marked it blocking for delivery of the notification only.
